title: Paul Thigpen's path from the woo to Catholicism

tellings.quote: he uh he encountered this stuff, the woo and everything else. And uh the woo led him to search for truth. He found his way into Catholicism.

plain: A podcast guest, Dylan Borland, told the host Jesse Michels about a man named Paul Thigpen. Borland says Thigpen ran into "the woo," meaning strange, unexplained experiences, and that this led him to search for truth and finally to become a Catholic. Borland tells it as an example of such experiences pushing someone toward religious faith.
